The front panel has labeled ports: OUT1-C, OUT2-C, IN, IN/OUT, and an ON/OFF button.
Text 'Fast charging' is printed below the ports.
The brand name 'PHILLY' is visible in the center.
Below the brand, '22.5W' is printed, likely indicating power output.

There is a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI AKINYEMI' over the image.

identity.model: 50000mAh 22.5W Super Fast Power Bank with 4 Built-in Cables

claims.claim: Original PHILLY 50000mAh 22.5W Super Fast Power Bank with 4 Built-in Cables
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the brand 'PHILLY' and '22.5W', but the 50000mAh capacity and the 4 built-in cables are not visible. The cables are not shown in any photo.
Photo 0 shows '22.5W' printed on the front of the device.
No photo shows the cables or their ports. The seller's text claims them, but there is no visual proof.

risks.risk: The 50000mAh capacity may be inaccurate or misleading.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the label or back panel showing the full specifications, including capacity.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a lower-capacity power bank, possibly 20000mAh or less.

risks.risk: The 4 built-in cables are not included or are not functional.
risks.proof: A photo showing the cables attached or stored within the power bank, with clear view of Type-C, Lightning, and other connectors.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a power bank without built-in cables, which reduces value significantly.

risks.risk: The device may not support 22.5W fast charging in practice.
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the power bank charging a device with a 22.5W output confirmed by a power meter or device screen.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a standard power bank without fast charging capability.

proof_requests: Photo of the back or side label showing full specifications including 50000mAh capacity.
Photo showing the 4 built-in cables (Type-C, Lightning, etc.) attached or stored in the device.
Video or photo of the power bank charging a device with 22.5W output confirmed.
response.reason: The brand and 22.5W output are visible, but key claims like 50000mAh capacity and 4 built-in cables are not visually confirmed. Without proof, the item cannot be priced accurately and risks being misrepresented.
